The '''Null Sectors''' were [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] where [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Khen Reo]] brought peace during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era.<ref name="TTF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[June]] [[2015]] that the Null Sectors were validated for a future map of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2015-06-30}}</ref>
